disposition_reason: The upstream package wp-11720-01's asset registration facts (source hash, chars, bytes, heading count, table locators, figure declarations, code-block/file-reference counts) are all independently verified correct against the live report 11720 markdown. However, the upstream kf_result.json envelope fails validation against the current schemas/kf_result.v1.schema.json on three counts: (1) provenance is missing the required 'source_uri' field; (2) provenance carries disallowed extra fields 'producer'/'emitted_at'/'notes' (additionalProperties=false); (3) the top level carries a disallowed 'claims' field. Because schema_pass is a hard acceptance criterion and the platform gate recomputes it independently, the upstream envelope must be corrected before it can be accepted.

blocking_findings.title: upstream kf_result.json fails schema validation (missing provenance.source_uri + disallowed fields)
blocking_findings.detail: jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(schemas/kf_result.v1.schema.json) rejects the upstream kf_result.json: 'provenance \'source_uri\' is a required property'; 'provenance Additional properties are not allowed (\'emitted_at\', \'notes\', \'producer\' were unexpected)'; 'Additional properties are not allowed (\'claims\' was unexpected)'. The upstream package's own self-check (report.md §⑥) claims 'schema_pass: ✅ PASS' on the basis of '包含全部 required 字段（package_id/task_type/report_id/provenance/outputs）', which is an incomplete reading of the schema: the schema additionally requires provenance.source_uri and forbids extra provenance/top-level fields.
blocking_findings.recommendation: Regenerate the upstream kf_result.json envelope with provenance containing source_uri='tensor://reports/11720', source_field='markdown', source_hash='sha256:d9d8b0a44cbd18c56e6d78706aa550c1d6e0d6649af816aa4a43d25d32791a59', and drop the disallowed 'producer'/'emitted_at'/'notes' provenance fields and the top-level 'claims' field (or move them into a schema-allowed location).
